reference_answer: Cards are charged when the order ships, so an order shipped in several parcels can show one charge per parcel.

query: Can I pay for a $40 order with buy-now-pay-later? And what about a $300 one?
reference_answer: BNPL is available on orders of $50–$1,000. So $40 isn't eligible, $300 is.

query: Can I pay by bank transfer for a big $600 order?
reference_answer: No. Bank transfers, cash and cheques aren't accepted. Accepted: credit/debit cards, digital wallets and Leafy gift cards, plus BNPL for $50–$1,000.

query: My card was closed and replaced. You owe me a $55 refund. Can you send it to my new card?
reference_answer: No. Refunds go only to the original payment method, even if closed. The bank normally passes it to the replacement card. Alternatively, take instant, non-expiring store credit.

query: How long until a $30 refund reaches my digital wallet versus my credit card?
reference_answer: Once issued: digital wallets 3–5 business days, cards 5–10 business days. Store credit is instant.

query: I used a 15% promo code but forgot to add my second code. Can I add it now? I'm also a Plus member.
reference_answer: No. One promo per order and it can't be added after ordering. Promo codes can't be combined with Plus member pricing on the same item; the better discount applies automatically.

query: I lost the code for the $100 gift card my sister bought me. Can you reissue it? Also can I cash it out?
reference_answer: Lost codes are reissued if the purchaser gives the gift card order number. Gift cards are never refundable for cash and never expire.

query: It's the 20th. I'm on Plant Club Collector and want to cancel. Will I be charged on the 25th?
reference_answer: Cancelling before the 25th affects the next box, so no 25th charge. Do it under "Account" > "Subscriptions". No cancellation fee.

query: I cancelled Plant Club Starter on the 26th. Do I still get October's box? Can I get a refund for it?
reference_answer: Changes on or after the 25th apply to the following month's box. An already-billed box isn't refunded and is still sent.

query: On Plant Club I already own a pothos, a ZZ plant and a snake plant. Can I make sure I don't get those? And can I pick my plant?
reference_answer: You can't choose the plant, but you can list up to 3 plants you own to avoid duplicates. The plant is chosen for your light level.

query: How long can I pause Plant Club for, and is there any fee?
reference_answer: Pause for up to 3 months from "Account" > "Subscriptions". No cancellation fee or minimum term.

query: Leafy Plus renewed yesterday for $59 and I didn't use it. Can I get my money back?
reference_answer: Yes, a full refund if cancelled within 14 days of purchase or renewal and no benefits used.

query: Does Leafy Plus give me 10% off plants?
reference_answer: No. The 10% member pricing is on pots and accessories only, not plants. Plus also gives free Standard shipping, free change-of-mind returns, 90-day guarantee and early rare drops.

query: I'm 17 and want to open an account to buy a succulent for myself. Can I?
reference_answer: No. Customers must be 18 or older to hold an account.

query: I think someone logged into my account and placed an order I didn't make.
reference_answer: Reset your password immediately. Support escalates to a Support Lead as suspected fraud/account access.

query: My $210 order was lost by the courier and I want a full refund. Also, this is the third time I've contacted you about it and I'm furious.
reference_answer: If lost, you can choose a free replacement or full refund. Because of the repeat contact (3+ times) and refund over $150, escalate to a human Support Lead. Be empathetic and give timeframes.

query: My plant arrived 3 days late and I'm annoyed. Is there anything you can do? Also, what are your phone hours?
reference_answer: Apologise; an agent can offer a one-time goodwill store credit up to $15 (never cash); more needs a Support Lead. There's no phone support. Chat is 8am–8pm Mon–Sat, email help@leafy.example answered within 1 business day.

query: I ordered a $80 fern and a $30 pot on Monday. Fern was out of stock and I got an email 2 days ago offering options but I haven't replied. It's been 3 days now. What happens, and will the pot still come?
reference_answer: No reply within 3 days means an automatic refund for the out-of-stock item (the fern). The KB doesn't say the pot is cancelled, so it should still ship; confirm in My Orders. Otherwise options were a similar plant, a wait up to 14 days, or a refund.

query: I ordered a monstera yesterday and a pot with it, now I want to cancel the whole thing. Also can I use a promo code I forgot? Order LF-204518.
reference_answer: Cancellation is free only within 2 hours of ordering; after that the order is in the packing queue and support can try to intercept before shipping, not guaranteed. Promo codes can't be added after ordering.

query: This is the THIRD time I'm writing about my missing parcel. Tracking hasn't moved in a week. Fix it now!!
reference_answer: Apologise. Tracking stuck 4+ business days qualifies for a courier investigation (up to 5 business days); if lost, customer chooses free replacement or full refund. Since the issue has been raised three or more times, escalate to a human Support Lead.

query: My fiddle leaf fig arrived with a snapped main stem 3 days ago. Why is nobody helping me? I want a refund.
reference_answer: DOA must be reported within 48 hours of delivery, so this now goes through the Plant Care Guarantee (30 days, or 90 for Plus): claim from My Orders with two photos (whole plant + close-up); reviewed within 2 business days. Remedy is a free replacement, not necessarily a refund. If customer insists, can escalate.

query: my dog just chewed a pothos leaf and is drooling a lot, what do I do??
reference_answer: Pothos is not pet-safe. Tell them to contact a vet or local poison control immediately, then escalate to a human Support Lead.

query: I was charged twice for LF-310022. Both show on my bank app. Give me my money back today.
reference_answer: First check whether one is a pending authorisation. If both posted, send order number and last four card digits (never full number/CVV); duplicate refunded within 3 business days of confirmation. A charge dispute may need escalation to a Support Lead. Orders in several parcels can show one charge per parcel.

query: Can I return a pothos I bought 10 days ago? I just don't like how it looks. Also is shipping refunded?
reference_answer: Live plants can't be returned for change of mind. Plant problems go through the Plant Care Guarantee or DOA only. Original shipping is refunded only when the whole order is returned due to Leafy's error.

query: I need to change the shipping address on my order, it shipped this morning. Just ask the courier to redirect it, you guys do that right?
reference_answer: No. Shipped orders' addresses can't be changed and couriers don't accept redirection requests from Leafy. Offer to escalate or help via courier investigation if it fails to arrive.

query: Is Leafy Plus worth it? I want free express shipping and also a refund if I don't like it.
reference_answer: Plus is $59/year: free Standard shipping with no minimum, free change-of-mind returns, 90-day guarantee, 10% on pots/accessories, early rare drops. No free Express (Express is $14.95 always). Full refund if cancelled within 14 days and no benefits used.

query: I bought Leafy Plus 20 days ago and used free shipping once. Cancel and refund me.
reference_answer: Refund requires cancelling within 14 days and no benefits used. Neither applies, so no refund; benefits continue until the end of the paid year. If customer insists/upset, can escalate.

query: Can you call me about my order? I hate typing.
reference_answer: No phone support. Chat is 8am–8pm Mon–Sat; email help@leafy.example answered within 1 business day.

query: The Plant Club box got billed on the 25th and I cancelled today the 27th. I want the money back and no box.
reference_answer: An already-billed box isn't refunded on cancellation and is still sent. No cancellation fee. Cancellation applies to the following month.

query: I want to pay for my order by bank transfer, and could I use buy-now-pay-later for a $30 pot?
reference_answer: Bank transfers aren't accepted. BNPL is only for orders of $50–$1,000, so not for $30 unless the order total reaches $50.

query: My credit card was closed and replaced. Refund LF-298811 to my new card please.
reference_answer: Refunds go only to the original payment method, even if closed; the bank normally passes it to the replacement card. Alternatively take instant, non-expiring Leafy store credit.

query: Ordered Thursday a calathea, still not shipped on Friday. Ridiculous! Also is it safe for my cat?
reference_answer: Live plants ship Mon–Wed only; orders after noon Wednesday ship next Monday. Calathea is pet-safe.

query: Your weather hold email says my plants are delayed. I'm going to just waive it, but if it dies in the cold, replace it right?
reference_answer: If waived, the guarantee still applies except for cold or heat damage in transit; DOA claims for cold/heat damage aren't accepted. So it would not be replaced for that. Holds can be up to 7 days.

query: I repotted my new peace lily into garden soil after a week and now it's wilting. Replace it.
reference_answer: Repotting into non-Leafy soil in first 14 days isn't covered. Also advise not to repot for 2–3 weeks. Free care advice is available from Plant Care Specialists.

query: How many replacements can I get for a snake plant that keeps dying? The first replacement also died.
reference_answer: Replacement gets its own 30-day guarantee, so it can be replaced once more; the second replacement has no guarantee. Claim with two photos from My Orders.

query: Need a $200 store credit for my terrible experience. Your delivery was 2 weeks late and I'm furious.
reference_answer: Agents may offer one-time goodwill credit up to $15; more, and anything over $150, needs a Support Lead. Apologise and escalate.

query: I'm 16 and want to open an account to buy a succulent for my mum.
reference_answer: Customers must be 18 or older to hold an account. Can't open one; a parent could order, gift orders get a free note.

query: Change my account email to my new address please. I don't have the password anymore.
reference_answer: Support can't change an account email over chat; customers change it after logging in. Password reset is the route to log in again.

query: I think someone logged in to my account and ordered stuff. What now?
reference_answer: Reset password immediately; support escalates to a Support Lead for possible unauthorised access/fraud.

query: What's the shipping cost for an 5ft ficus to Alaska, and can I get it express?
reference_answer: XL plants (usually over 4 ft) add $20 handling and ship Standard only. Remote/island addresses are Zone 3: 5–8 business days, no Express. Standard $7.95, free at $75+.

query: Ordered a pot and a plant. The pot arrived cracked, plant fine. It's been 2 days. What are my options? It was a $35 pot.
reference_answer: Within 48 hours, report with photos of item and box. Replacement or refund; items under $40 usually don't need to be returned.

query: Got a rubber plant instead of the ZZ plant I ordered. Do I have to send it back? And how fast will the right one arrive?
reference_answer: Correct item ships free by Express where zone allows, with a free return label. A wrong live plant can be kept at no charge.

query: I returned a bag of soil, it's been 8 business days and no refund. Hello??
reference_answer: Refunds are issued within 5 business days of the return reaching the warehouse; then cards take 5–10 business days. Check whether it arrived; escalate if needed. Note opened soil isn't returnable unless faulty.

query: My return label expired. Can I still use it? I got it 10 days ago.
reference_answer: Labels expire after 7 days. The KB doesn't say a new one can be issued; offer to escalate/check via support. Return must be within 30 days of delivery for non-living items.

query: The plant I ordered is out of stock and I got an email. I didn't reply. Will I be charged?
reference_answer: No reply within 3 days leads to automatic refund for that item. Options were similar plant, wait up to 14 days, or refund. Cards are charged on shipping.

query: Price of my monstera dropped $12 four days after I bought it. Can I get the difference? Also it was a flash sale item.
reference_answer: Price drop within 7 days gives the difference as store credit once per item, but flash sales and clearance are excluded.

query: Can I use two promo codes on my order and also my Plus discount on pots?
reference_answer: One promo code per order; can't be combined with Plus pricing on the same item—the better discount applies automatically.

query: I lost my gift card code!! My aunt bought it for me last month.
reference_answer: Lost codes are reissued if the purchaser provides the gift card order number. Gift cards never expire and aren't refundable for cash.

query: Can I get a gift card refunded to cash? I bought a $100 one by mistake.
reference_answer: Gift cards are not refundable for cash.

query: Do you ship to Canada? And to my PO box for a fern?
reference_answer: No international shipping. Live plants can't go to PO boxes; PO boxes are for non-living items only.

query: Switch my Plant Club from Starter to Collector and also pause for 4 months. Today is the 20th.
reference_answer: Change plan or pause from Account > Subscriptions; changes before the 25th affect the next box. Pause is up to 3 months max, not 4. Collector is $49 vs Starter $29.

query: The Plant Club plant I got is one I already own. This is the second time! Fix it.
reference_answer: Customers can list up to 3 owned plants to avoid duplicates. Repeat issue; apologise, offer goodwill up to $15 and escalate if repeated three or more times or customer insists. KB doesn't cover replacing duplicates directly.

query: Tracking says delivered but there's no package. It's been just a couple hours. Do I wait?
reference_answer: Delivered-but-not-arrived is a reason to contact support: courier investigation up to 5 business days; if lost, free replacement or full refund. Tracking can take up to 24 hours to update.

query: Can I exchange the 8-inch pot I bought for a 10-inch one directly?
reference_answer: No direct exchanges: return the item (within 30 days, unused, original packaging) and place a new order. Change-of-mind return costs $6.95 (free for Plus).

query: Leaves of my new pothos turned yellow, two old ones, on day 5. Replace it now.
reference_answer: Yellowing of one or two older leaves in the first two weeks is normal transplant stress, not covered alone. Advise watering only when top inch is dry, avoid direct sun first week; Plant Care Specialists can advise.

query: What time can I chat with a plant specialist on Sunday? My ZZ plant is drooping.
reference_answer: Plant Care Specialists are on chat 9am–5pm Mon–Fri, so not Sunday; email is available. Advice is free. General chat is 8am–8pm Mon–Sat.

query: I want to delete my account and also keep my Plant Club going.
reference_answer: Deletion (Account > Privacy) takes up to 30 days and cancels subscriptions, so Plant Club can't continue. Already-billed box still sent.

query: Cancelled order LF-221100 an hour ago and the money still shows pending on my card! Scam?
reference_answer: Pending authorisation on a cancelled order drops off in 3–7 business days depending on bank; Leafy can't release it faster. Cards are charged on shipping. Not a charge unless it posted.

query: I ordered Wednesday at 3pm. When will my plant get to me in Zone 2 with express?
reference_answer: Plant orders after noon Wednesday ship next Monday. Zone 2 Express is 2 business days after shipping, so arrives about Wednesday (subject to weather holds). Express is $14.95.

query: I want a full refund for my entire order because Leafy shipped the wrong plant AND a late order. Also refund shipping.
reference_answer: Wrong item is fixed with free Express correct item and a free return label; wrong live plant can be kept. Original shipping is refunded only if whole order is returned due to Leafy's error. Offer goodwill up to $15; escalate if insists.

query: How do I get my data from Leafy? Also are my details sold?
reference_answer: Data can be downloaded under Account > Privacy. The KB doesn't cover whether details are sold; offer to escalate.

query: Do you sell plant insurance or offer a loyalty points program?
reference_answer: KB doesn't cover loyalty points or insurance. Related: Plant Care Guarantee and Leafy Plus. Offer to escalate.

query: I'm a Plus member for 2 months and my plant from 50 days ago is dying. Am I covered?
reference_answer: Yes if the plant was ordered while membership active: 90-day guarantee. Claim in My Orders with two photos; reviewed within 2 business days. Free replacement of same plant.

query: my order LF-305577 is in the packing queue. i need to add one more pot, can you add it?
reference_answer: After 2 hours orders can't be changed online. Support may try to intercept before shipping but it's not guaranteed; suggest placing a new order. Free Standard at $75+ applies per order.

query: The $180 refund for my returned grow light hasn't arrived and support told me last week it would. I've asked twice already.
reference_answer: Refund over $150 requires a Support Lead, so escalate. Refund issued within 5 business days of warehouse receipt, then 5–10 business days for cards, 3–5 for wallets.

query: Is the spider plant safe for my toddler to chew on? Just curious. Kids put everything in their mouths.
reference_answer: KB lists spider plant as pet-safe but doesn't state toddler safety. If anyone may have eaten a plant, contact doctor/poison control immediately; offer to escalate.

query: Gift for my sister: can the note include the price and be 300 characters? Also hide the price on the slip.
reference_answer: Gift note is free and up to 200 characters, so 300 is too long. Prices are never printed on gift packing slips.

query: I waited a week for a reply after emailing and now my plant died. Compensate me.
reference_answer: Email is answered within 1 business day, so apologise. Goodwill store credit up to $15 for delayed reply; plant death goes via the Plant Care Guarantee with two photos. More needs a Support Lead.

query: I ordered a monstera 3 hours ago and realized I put the wrong address. Can I change it in My Orders?
reference_answer: No. The free change/cancel window is 2 hours, so it's now in the packing queue and can't be changed online. Support can try to intercept it before it ships, but that's not guaranteed. Offer to try.

query: My order LF-204518 shipped yesterday. Can you ask the courier to redirect it to my office?
reference_answer: No. Shipped orders can't have the address changed, and couriers don't accept redirection requests from Leafy. Offer other help, e.g. tracking or a courier investigation if it goes missing.

query: I bought a fern and I just don't like how it looks in my room. Can I send it back?
reference_answer: No. Live plants can't be returned for change of mind. Plant problems go through the Plant Care Guarantee or Damaged on Arrival.

query: I opened a bag of potting soil but only used a little. Can I return it within 30 days?
reference_answer: No. Opened soil can't be returned unless it's faulty. If it's faulty, it can be returned within 30 days of delivery, free.

query: I got my return label 9 days ago and never dropped off the parcel. Can I still use it?
reference_answer: Labels expire after 7 days, so it's expired. The KB doesn't say how to get a new label, so offer to escalate or check from My Orders. Don't promise one.

query: Can I get Express shipping to my cabin on an island off the coast?
reference_answer: No. Island and remote addresses are Zone 3, where Express isn't available. Standard takes 5–8 business days.

query: I ordered a 5 ft fiddle leaf fig. Can I get it by Express because it's a gift for tomorrow?
reference_answer: No. XL plants (usually over 4 ft) ship Standard only and add a $20 handling fee. Plants also ship Mon–Wed only.

query: Can you send my succulent to my PO box? It's the only address I have.
reference_answer: No. Live plants can't ship to PO boxes. PO boxes work only for non-living items.

query: You emailed that a cold snap is delaying my plants. I'll reply to waive the hold so it ships now. If it freezes, can I still claim DOA?
reference_answer: No. If the hold is waived, cold or heat damage in transit isn't covered, and DOA claims for it aren't accepted. The Guarantee still applies otherwise. Without the waiver, the hold can last up to 7 days.

query: My tracking hasn't updated in 2 business days. Can you start a lost-parcel investigation?
reference_answer: Not yet. Contact support once tracking hasn't moved for 4 business days, or if it shows delivered but nothing arrived. Tracking can take up to 24 hours to update.

query: My plant was delivered 5 weeks ago and it's now dying. I'm on the normal plan. Can I claim a replacement?
reference_answer: No. The guarantee is 30 days from delivery (90 for Plus members on plants ordered while active). A claim after the window isn't covered. Free care advice is available from a Plant Care Specialist.

query: Two of the older leaves on my new pothos went yellow in week one. Does the guarantee cover that?
reference_answer: Not on its own. Yellowing of one or two older leaves in the first two weeks is normal transplant stress. Care advice is available.

query: I repotted my plant into my own soil on day 5 and now it has root rot. Can I get a replacement?
reference_answer: Probably not. Repotting into non-Leafy soil in the first 14 days isn't covered. A claim can be submitted with photos for specialist review.

query: My replacement plant died too. Do I get another one?
reference_answer: If it's the first replacement, it has its own new 30-day guarantee and can be replaced once more. That second replacement has no guarantee. If it was already the second replacement, no further replacement.

query: How many photos do I need for a plant claim, and do I have to mail the dead plant back?
reference_answer: At least two photos (whole plant plus close-up), submitted via My Orders within the window. No need to send the plant back. A specialist reviews within 2 business days.

query: My plant arrived Monday and today is Thursday. The stem is snapped. Can I still report it as damaged?
reference_answer: If more than 48 hours since delivery, it's past the DOA window. Plant issues then go through the Plant Care Guarantee, with at least two photos from My Orders.

query: A few leaves were bent and some soil spilled in the box. Can I get a replacement?
reference_answer: No. A few bent leaves or loose soil is normal, not damage. DOA covers snapped main stems, a cracked pot, exposed roots, or dead or severely wilted plants.

query: You sent me a peperomia instead of the pothos I ordered. Do I have to return it?
reference_answer: No. A wrong live plant can be kept at no charge. The correct item ships free by Express where the zone allows.

query: I was charged twice for LF-310022. Both show as posted. What do I do?
reference_answer: Send the order number and last four card digits (never the full number, security code or password). The duplicate is refunded within 3 business days of confirmation. Note that multi-parcel orders can show one charge per parcel.

query: I cancelled my order but my bank still shows a pending charge. Can you remove it today?
reference_answer: No. A pending authorisation on a cancelled order drops off in 3–7 business days depending on the bank. Leafy can't release it faster.

query: My old card was closed. Can you refund to my new card instead?
reference_answer: No. Refunds go only to the original payment method. The bank normally passes it to the replacement card. Alternatively, the customer can take instant, never-expiring Leafy store credit.

query: Can I pay with a bank transfer for a $300 order?
reference_answer: No. Accepted: cards, digital wallets, Leafy gift cards. Bank transfers and cash aren't accepted. Buy-now-pay-later is available for $50–$1,000.

query: Can I use buy-now-pay-later for a $35 pot?
reference_answer: No. Buy-now-pay-later is available on orders of $50–$1,000 only.

query: The monstera I bought 5 days ago dropped $10 in price. Can I get the difference?
reference_answer: Yes, within 7 days of purchase, as store credit, once per item. It excludes flash sales and clearance, so check whether the item was one of those.

query: I forgot to enter my promo code at checkout. Can you add it now? Also can I combine it with my Plus pricing?
reference_answer: No. Promo codes can't be added after ordering. They also can't combine with Plus member pricing on the same item; the better discount applies automatically.

query: I got a gift card for my birthday but don't want it. Can I get cash back?
reference_answer: No. Gift cards are not refundable for cash. They never expire.

query: I lost the code to a gift card I bought. Can you reissue it?
reference_answer: Yes, lost codes are reissued if the purchaser provides the gift card order number.

query: I cancelled Plant Club on the 26th. Will I still get next month's box, and do I get the money back?
reference_answer: Changes on or after the 25th apply to the following month's box. An already-billed box (charged on the 25th) isn't refunded and is still sent. No cancellation fee.

query: Can I pick which plant I get in my Collector box? I really want a rare calathea.
reference_answer: No. Customers can't choose the plant. They can list up to 3 plants they own to avoid duplicates. Plants are matched to light level.

query: Can I pause my Starter plan for 6 months while I travel?
reference_answer: No. Pausing is up to 3 months. They can skip, or cancel with no fee or minimum term, in Account > Subscriptions.

query: I bought Leafy Plus 20 days ago and haven't used any perks. Can I get a refund?
reference_answer: No. A full refund requires cancelling within 14 days of purchase or renewal and no benefits used. After that, no refund, but benefits continue until the end of the paid year.

query: My Leafy Plus renewed this morning and I didn't use any benefits yet. Can I cancel for a full refund?
reference_answer: Yes, if within 14 days of renewal and no benefits used, the full $59 is refunded.

query: I'm a Plus member and my plant from before I joined is dying at day 50. Does the 90-day guarantee apply?
reference_answer: No. The 90-day guarantee applies only to plants ordered while the membership is active. A plant bought before joining has the standard 30 days, so it's out of window.

query: Can I call you guys? Typing is hard for me.
reference_answer: No phone support. Options: chat 8am–8pm Mon–Sat, or email help@leafy.example, answered within 1 business day.

query: It's Saturday afternoon. Can I chat with a plant specialist about my drooping calathea?
reference_answer: Specialist chat is 9am–5pm Mon–Fri, so not on Saturday. They can email, or general support chat is open Mon–Sat 8am–8pm. Care advice is free for anyone.

query: My cat chewed a leaf of my peace lily and is drooling. What should I do?
reference_answer: Contact a vet or local poison control immediately. Peace lily isn't pet-safe. Then escalate to a human Support Lead as a safety issue.

query: Which of these is safe for my dog: calathea, snake plant, or spider plant?
reference_answer: Calathea and spider plant are pet-safe. Snake plant is not.

query: I'm 16 and want to open an account to buy a pothos with my own money. Is that okay?
reference_answer: No. Customers must be 18 or older to hold an account.

query: Can you change the email on my account to my new address? I can't log in to the old one anymore.
reference_answer: Support can't change an account email over chat. Customers change it themselves after logging in. The KB doesn't cover recovery without access; offer to escalate.

query: This is the third time I've written about my missing refund and nobody fixed it. I want a manager.
reference_answer: Same issue raised three or more times is an escalation trigger. Apologise and escalate to a human Support Lead; don't promise outcomes beyond policy.

query: My $220 order was lost in transit. I want a refund AND a replacement.
reference_answer: If confirmed lost after the courier investigation (up to 5 business days), the customer chooses a free replacement or a full refund, not both. A refund over $150 requires a Support Lead, so escalate.

query: My plant arrived 3 days late and I'm furious. What can you give me?
reference_answer: Apologise. Agents may offer one-time store credit up to $15 for a poor experience; goodwill is never cash. More requires a Support Lead.

query: Do you ship plants to Canada?
reference_answer: No. There's no international shipping.

query: The pot I ordered is out of stock after I ordered a plant and pot together. Plus my plant is cracked. What happens?
reference_answer: Out of stock: an email within 24 hours offers a similar item of equal or higher value, waiting up to 14 days, or a refund for that item; no reply in 3 days means an automatic refund. For the cracked item, report DOA within 48 hours with photos of the item and box. Plant: free replacement on the next plant shipping day, or refund.

query: Do you offer a plant-sitting service or repotting help in person while I'm away?
reference_answer: The KB doesn't cover this. Don't guess; offer free care advice from a Plant Care Specialist or escalate.

query: I want to delete my account but I have an active Plant Club subscription. What happens?
reference_answer: Delete under Account > Privacy. Deletion takes up to 30 days and cancels subscriptions. An already-billed box isn't refunded on cancellation and is still sent.
